items.exampleEn: Can you recognize the singer from her voice?
items.exampleZh: 你能從聲音認出這位歌手嗎？

items.exampleEn: The analysis shows that sales are rising.
items.exampleZh: 分析顯示銷售量正在上升。

items.exampleEn: Can you prove that this old coin is real?
items.exampleZh: 你能證明這枚舊硬幣是真的嗎？

items.exampleEn: He has a theory about why the plan failed.
items.exampleZh: 他對計畫為什麼失敗有一套理論。

items.exampleEn: She hasn't responded to my email yet.
items.exampleZh: 她還沒回覆我的電子郵件。

items.exampleEn: In reality, the job was much harder than I thought.
items.exampleZh: 實際上，那份工作比我想的難多了。

items.exampleEn: The two problems are closely related.
Don't assume that every website tells the truth.
items.exampleZh: 別以為每個網站說的都是真的。

items.sentenceEn: Please respond to the customer within one day.
items.sentenceZh: 請在一天之內回覆客戶。

items.audioEn: I assumed the shop was open on Sunday, but it was closed.
items.audioZh: 我以為那家店星期天有開，結果沒開。
items.questionZh: 說話者星期天遇到什麼事？

items.sentenceEn: It took me a while to recognize my old classmate.
items.sentenceZh: 我過了一會兒才認出我的老同學。

items.sentenceEn: Your test results prove that you studied hard.
items.sentenceZh: 你的考試成績證明你很用功。

items.stemEn: He couldn't ____ that he was at work that day, so nobody believed him.
items.stemZh: 他無法證明那天他在上班，所以沒人相信他。

items.stemEn: The idea sounds good, but in ____ it is very hard to do.
items.stemZh: 這個點子聽起來不錯，但實際上很難做到。

items.passageEn: Professor Kao studies why people become friends. Her theory was that people relate more easily to others who share their hobbies. To prove this, her team did an analysis of three thousand online messages. In reality, the results were far more complex. Many people responded more often to friends with different hobbies. Professor Kao no longer assumes that the answer is easy. She now recognizes that friendship is a complex thing.
items.passageZh: 高教授研究人為什麼會成為朋友。她原本的理論是：人比較容易和興趣相同的人有共鳴。為了證明這一點，她的團隊分析了三千則網路訊息。實際上，結果複雜得多。很多人反而更常回應興趣不同的朋友。高教授不再假定答案很簡單。她現在認為，友誼是很複雜的事。

questions.questionZh: 高教授原本的理論是什麼？
options: 在網路上比較容易交朋友
興趣不同的人反而比較合得來
興趣相同的人較有共鳴
證實她原本的理論完全正確
更常回應興趣不同的人
大家幾乎都不回朋友的訊息

referenceEn: I assumed you didn't work today.
I assumed that you were not working today.
rubricZh: assume 表示「以為、假定」，後面接 that 子句（that 可省略）
「以為」說的是之前的想法，可用過去式（例如 assumed）
寫 I thought… 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 recognize 造一個句子，說說你認出（或沒認出）某人或某樣東西的經驗。
referenceEn: I recognized my teacher at the train station yesterday.
I didn't recognize my cousin because he was so tall.
rubricZh: recognize 表示「認出」，後面直接接受詞（例如人、東西等）
過去的經驗可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 recognized、didn't recognize）
